Amelia Chen: Afternoon facilitators — quick heads up, I need to swap out of 3pm onboarding for NovaHealth today. family thing. Can someone pick up? :pray:
Jorge Rivera: I can cover but only until 4:15pm PST. Is that enough? :raised_hands:
Priya Kapoor: I can jump in for the last 30m and handle the Q&A + rollout checklist.
Amelia Chen: Amazing, Jorge covers 3:00–4:15, Priya takes 4:15–4:45. Thanks both. Can someone update the calendar and preread link? :thumbsup:
sched-bot: Calendar updated: Host set to Jorge Rivera + Priya Kapoor. Meeting description updated with preread link — https://internal.re/redwood/nova-preread
Liam O'Neill: Quick note — NovaHealth renewal flagged as 'watch' last week. Can we add a 5–10min segment on Dedicated capacity planning to reassure them? recommend Priya handle cost/Q&A.
Priya Kapoor: Yep adding a 10m slot at 4:05 for Dedicated overview. Will keep it high-level and capture follow-ups.
Amelia Chen: Also, please record session and paste recording + 2-question pulse survey in the account thread. We should capture feedback and any migration blockers.
Jorge Rivera: Will record. Could someone paste the short survey we use? I can post it in chat when session ends.
Amelia Chen: Survey (copy):
```
1) Was the session useful? (Yes / Somewhat / No)
2) Biggest blocker to adoption (short text)
```
Jorge Rivera: Posted the recording + survey link after wrap. :white_check_mark:
Priya Kapoor: I'll follow up with a short action list and tag the renewal owner if we get cost concerns. Thanks team.
Amelia Chen: Appreciate it — saved my day! :sparkles:
